rule: If two measured runs with different max-steps produce the same failing mutations (same reason=max_steps, same score), further blanket step increases are low-value. Switch hypothesis to diagnosis quality, tool selection order, or repair prompt. Design the smallest experiment that tests the new hypothesis (e.g. single-mutation + forced read-before-write + tool-trace inspection).
